commit 4a4844abe04cd54d51c207f1a07b987fcfdc4148
Author:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Sun Jun 16 22:52:07 2024 +0000
Commit:     Rob Lemley <rob@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Sun Jun 16 22:52:07 2024 +0000

    Bug 1902902 - Port bug 1898183: Always set MOZ_SOURCE_REPO and MOZ_SOURCE_CHANGESET. r=darktrojan
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D213902

diff --git a/build/moz.configure/gecko_source.configure b/build/moz.configure/gecko_source.configure
index 319150c81a0..8b7839f2e1b 100644
--- a/build/moz.configure/gecko_source.configure
+++ b/build/moz.configure/gecko_source.configure
@@ -165,11 +165,6 @@ def comm_source_repo(from_environ, from_config, automation):
     log.info("COMM_SOURCE_REPOSITORY: {}".format(rv.comm_repo))
     log.info("COMM_SOURCE_CHANGESET: {}".format(rv.comm_rev))
 
-    # Used by old-configure to set in buildconfig. This is configure's environment
-    # not the same as used by the build itself.
-    environ["MOZ_SOURCE_REPO"] = rv.comm_repo
-    environ["MOZ_SOURCE_CHANGESET"] = rv.comm_rev
-
     return rv
 
 
@@ -256,6 +251,8 @@ def gecko_source_repo(from_environ, from_heuristics, automation):
 
 
 set_config("MOZ_COMM_SOURCE_REPO", comm_source_repo.comm_repo)
+imply_option("MOZ_SOURCE_REPO", comm_source_repo.comm_repo, reason="MOZ_SOURCE_REPO")
 set_config("MOZ_COMM_SOURCE_CHANGESET", comm_source_repo.comm_rev)
+imply_option("MOZ_SOURCE_CHANGESET", comm_source_repo.comm_rev, reason="MOZ_SOURCE_CHANGESET")
 set_config("MOZ_GECKO_SOURCE_REPO", gecko_source_repo.gecko_repo)
 set_config("MOZ_GECKO_SOURCE_CHANGESET", gecko_source_repo.gecko_rev)
